articles.title: Army Medicine Celebrates Army Animal Care Specialists
articles.summary: National Veterinary Technician Week is celebrated annually by the National Association of Veterinary Technicians in America and the American Veterinary Medical Association to recognize the work that veterinary technicians provide. For Army Medicine that means recognizing their Army Animal Care Specialists.

articles.title: Omaha District, ERDC collaborate to monitor Fort Peck Dam flood gates
articles.summary: Engineers from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Omaha District and the Engineer Research and Development Center recently collaborated at the Fort Peck Dam to develop a long-term monitoring approach for the massive gates that help control water flow through the dam’s flood tunnels.
